verdict.rationale: Fern Editor is documented as letting content writers, product managers, and marketers update documentation without code, markdown, or Git, which covers the core of the story. The pack does not show how editor changes flow back into the docs repository, so the 'same source of truth' half is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that editor edits commit or open PRs to the same git-backed source, details on the review/publish workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
